entities.name: Jean-Joseph Carriès
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Joseph Marie Carriès was a French sculptor, ceramist, and miniaturist. His ceramic work is mostly in stoneware, and part of the French art pottery movement, and includes many faces and heads, often with grotesque expressions, but he made several conventional pots, often with thick unctuous ash glaze effects in the Japanese style.
